events.title: A First Look at the Cathedral
events.summary: The demo introduced you to the great work: an edifice that rises stage by stage and will put your monastery's logistics to the test!The Belfry has only a single wing, but the Cathedral is far bigger: it will have several, built as you progress through the game. Your brand-new monastery will start by laying the Choir's foundation, then move on to the Crossing, the transepts, and so on. events.title: Welcome to the 3rd Dimension!
events.summary: The board in the Cellarer has made the move from 2D to 3D, literally!When I started working on the game, the simple 2D board with its IDE-like interface was a deliberate choice. It let me focus on buildings, paths, production chains, and all the carts trying to find their way through the network.From the first concepts, I wanted to evoke the cosy feeling of a slow-paced tabletop game. events.title: Welcome to the Monastery
events.summary: The free demo of the Cellarer is now available! Discover the whole of the game's first Tier: establish your first production chains, sustain the needs of your monastery, welcome new monks, produce more goods, and finally raise the monastery's first great work: the Belfry!I've spent quite some time polishing this first Tier, and I now consider it ready to be put into players' hands. For me, this is the starting point for giving the game its first real visibility and, of course, gathering feedback
